commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat: enhance session filtering and sorting logic
commits.body:
- Updated SessionListView and SessionSidebar components to improve session filtering based on attention reasons.
- Modified sorting logic to sort sessions by createdAt only, ensuring a stable chronological order.
- Adjusted session counting logic to accurately reflect active, waiting, and done statuses based on attention reasons.
- Replaced Editor component with FileExplorer in SessionView for better file management.
- Removed unused WebGL addon from Terminal component, simplifying rendering logic.
- Improved URL generation for session notifications to use query parameters instead of path segments.
- Added comprehensive unit tests for session sorting, filtering, counting, and URL parameter handling.
- Updated pnpm lockfile to include better-sqlite3 and its types for improved database interactions.

- Added an archive button to the SessionCard component, allowing users to archive sessions.
- Implemented logic to filter and count sessions based on the new 'init' status.
- Updated session sorting to display the most recently created sessions first.
- Enhanced keyboard shortcuts for session navigation and tab switching.
- Added tests for keyboard shortcuts and session sorting/filtering logic.
- Updated the SessionPollingContext to manage archived sessions and fetch them from the server.
- Modified the SessionInfo type to include an 'archivedAt' timestamp for archived sessions.
- Updated UI components to reflect changes in session status and environment icons.
